verdict.rationale: Factory's docs describe delegating end-to-end feature work to Droid: it analyzes the codebase, proposes and applies changes, and Linear/Jira integrations explicitly state Droid will 'investigate, implement, and test the work.' Missions support structured multi-feature implementation with defined success criteria. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of test-writing quality and no third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
